name: swarm-extensions
title: Swarm Extensions
description: Write, install, and manage swarm extensions: TypeScript hook bundles that block, modify, or observe task creation, follow-ups, Slack routing, heartbeat remediation, and tool calls. Covers catalog-only install of predefined extensions (templates/extensions, YAML or JSON manifests) and the scripts, schedules, workflows and skills they ship, the hook contract, where to fetch swarm-extension.d.ts, the extension-catalog, extension-install and extension-list tools, config schemas, and the operator enable step.
